# Jordan Avery — VP of Operations, Brightwave

- **Goes by:** Jordan
- **Full name:** Jordan Avery
- **Role:** VP of Operations; member of the leadership team.
- **Company:** [Brightwave](../context/company.md) — mid-market consumer-goods distributor.
- **Reports to:** [Morgan Chen](../people/morgan-chen.md), COO.

## Mandate
Own fulfilment, warehousing, and supplier operations. Accountable for on-time delivery, cost per
order, and the operations side of the [Orion](../projects/orion.md) initiative (confidential).

   peak-season capacity holds.
2. **Orion** — operational due diligence and integration planning (confidential).

- Guards Tuesday/Thursday deep-work blocks.
